Spacecraft SSS-2B
Type CubeSat
Units or mass 3U
Status Reentry 2024-12-26. Operational (Twitter and SatNOGS reports with data as of 2023-12-19)
Launched 2023-04-15
NORAD ID 56184
Deployer EXOpod 12U/16U [Exolaunch]
Launcher Falcon 9 (Transporter-7)
Entity name TUBITAK-UZAY (TÜBİTAK Space Technologies Research Institute)
Institution University
Entity Academic / Education
Nation Turkey
Partners Asia-Pacific Space Cooperation Organization (APSCO)
Oneliner

Educational training and capacity building in space technology development.
Description

Hands-on practical training until the flight model is made, and thus to contribute to the development of space education system among MS, as well as to enhance the capacity building of Universities in space technology development for senior undergraduates and above levels in both aspects of knowledge and engineering practices.
Notes

Not part of the SSS constellation anymore because the SSS-1 and SSS-2A launched in 2021 and inter-satellite communication and formation flying equipment have been removed.
